data.one_liner: Lightweight and customizable HTTP client logger based on Talker for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Logs HTTP requests, responses, and errors into Talker using the http_interceptor package. It supports customizing headers, printing curl commands, hiding sensitive headers, and filtering logs.
use_when: You are using the http package with http_interceptor and want to log requests using Talker.
You need to print cURL commands for debugging HTTP requests.
You want to hide sensitive headers like Authorization or Cookie from logs.
avoid_when: You are using the dio package instead of http (use talker_dio_logger instead).
you are not using Talker for logging.
strengths: Integrates seamlessly with Talker and http_interceptor.
Allows hiding sensitive headers and filtering specific logs.
weaknesses: Strictly dependent on http_interceptor and Talker.
Limited to the http package ecosystem.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and pass TalkerHttpLogger into your InterceptedClient interceptors list.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you just need standard HTTP requests without Talker-based logging or interceptors.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using Dio as your HTTP client instead of the basic http package.
